name: Hanayome o Korosu Yume
source:
Kozue has liked Michiyuki, a childhood friend of the same sex, since he was a child.
However, Kozue's feelings of love never reached him, and Michiyuki gets married.

Michiyuki, who is getting married tomorrow, pays a visit to Kozue...

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/2816]NovelGame[/url]]
translation:
梢从小就喜欢着同性的青梅竹马道行。
然而，他的爱意始终未能传达，道行即将结婚。

婚礼前一天，道行前来拜访梢……

[译自[url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/2816]NovelGame[/url]]
